text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on 1st place,
Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Big Sis Groove...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Did you take a good, hard look?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've burned it into my memory.
...Though I already knew.

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text: —Groove-nee... Do you think I can win my next race?

text_block_list.name: Young Dura
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think about having to win,
my heart races... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—It seems she deeply cherishes
the memories from back then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, you are now a splendid Umamusume in your own right.
...You've overcome your hardships.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You've gotten strong, Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is the year you'll take on
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, there will be no problem.
Go win... and forge a new chapter in history, Dura."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And also...—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No.
Well then, good work.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Let's head back
and discuss our target races.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: ...Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It's right after a race. I know I can't train.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Still, getting praised by Big Sis Groove made me...
choice_data_list: Did you feel like doing something?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training is certainly out of the question, but...
she should still be able to study and do research.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, I recorded a TV special I was interested in
before the race. It was a racing program, and they had even
teased a segment on the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'—"
choice_data_list: Alright, should we study up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
!
Must be nice.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...And.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad we got to meet.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Guess I'll report in.
That there's nothing left to worry about with her."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After returning to the academy, we immediately played the recording.
It seemed to start with a look back at the history of Japanese Umamusume taking on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe—
choice_data_list: Oh, it's Speed Symboli!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Speed Symboli...
The first Japanese Umamusume
to take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘She finished outside the top places. The defeat of an Umamusume who dominated top-level races in Japan at the time...
It starkly illustrated the gap between Japan and the rest of the world.’"
choice_data_list: (Still, she carved her own path.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "And from this point on, Japanese Umamusume began their challenge against the 'world'—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And after looking back at the history of those challenges,
the broadcast cut to the studio, shifting the conversation to future bids for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
“There are many challenges to overcome in order to win on the world stage.
The difficulties of overseas expeditions, not to mention major differences in turf and track elevations...”

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "In that case, we should send girls who show promise on European turf abroad starting from their Junior year, and have them make that their main battlefield!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: "For example, taking thorough advance preparation, El Condor Pasa! Judging that a spot entry would be tough, she arrived at the venue six months in advance—"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
“—She took 2nd place, 2nd place!
And that was in a fierce battle against the strongest Umamusume!
If only she had more preparation time than her……!”

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"Preparing locally well in advance... makes sense.
However... this might just be romanticism on the part of the fans, but..."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume who wins the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe
should be a champion of Japan."

text_block_list.name: Commentator B
text_block_list.text: "Our strongest Umamusume becoming the strongest in the world... Doesn't that sound like an incredible dream?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text:
"No, I get it! I totally get it.
You want to see the moment our number one becomes the world's number one, right?"
choice_data_list: ...I know how you feel.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: (If it's Dura, surely...!)

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"—Who do you want to see challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe this year?
Ahead of the upcoming spring GⅠ campaign,
we surveyed racing fans across the nation."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Duramente, of course!
She's been saying she wanted to challenge
the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe since her debut."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"She showed plenty of talent in her Classic year!
This year, I want to see her give her strongest
performance at Longchamp!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: Good for you, Dura!
Good for you, Dura!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "I want Kitasan Black to take on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "I became a huge fan seeing your all-out run in the Kikuka-sho!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "She's incredibly tough, and I think she's suited for overseas campaigns too. If she keeps growing at this rate, even the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe is surely...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I'd say Satono Crown-san.
She fits the international vibe perfectly,
and I want her to show the world the strength of Japan's elite!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text: "I'm definitely on Duramente's side! After all, she's the absolute strongest Umamusume to me!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "In the viewer poll for this program, Duramente held a slight lead as the Umamusume people want to see challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe. However—"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It cracked.
choice_data_list: Everyone has their own idea of who's the strongest, after all.
Everyone has their own idea of who's the strongest, after all.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: To me, it's...
choice_data_list: Isn't there someone special who'd be happy to see you win?
Isn't there someone special who'd be overjoyed to see you win?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘The victor has just been decided!
After an intense, nail-biting clash against their fateful rival,
the one to conquer the World Championships is—’"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...They're here.
Lots of them.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Grandfather, Father, Mother,
Gro-nee...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I put my heart into cheering.
If she wins, it will make me so very happy.
choice_data_list: I'd be happy no matter who wins the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, but...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—If the one I believe is the strongest wins...
I'll be even... even happier.
choice_data_list: That's who you are to me!
To me, you're you, and that's what matters!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Special, huh?
choice_data_list: Dura?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Duramente sank into deep thought.
She seemed to have felt something, but... she might have trouble putting it into words.
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, we haven't decided on our next goal yet.
Come to think of it, we haven't decided on our next goal yet.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...!
Ah, that's right.
choice_data_list: Do you have any preferences?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The primary goal, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, is in October.
I will likely run a few races leading up to it to get my body in top shape.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Has Kitasan Black announced
her next race yet?
choice_data_list: It's the "Osaka Hai."
It's the "Osaka Hai."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai is a spring GⅠ race.
Open starting from the Senior Class, it's where you will cross swords with seasoned upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case,
I want to head to the Osaka Hai too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a bit surprising.
To think Duramente would choose her next race
with the goal of chasing a single Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I have a feeling
I'm about to grasp something.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next target race was decided: the Osaka Hai.
